messages.en_US: Bianca: A. Mazing. Isn't it?{VAR BE01}

en_US: Now, now. Don't be like that.
Please reconsider and select a Pokémon!{VAR BE01}

messages.en_US: Then... It's time to play Dress Up!{VAR BE01}

en_US: I eagerly anticipate seeing you
on stage again!

messages.en_US: I hope you continue to enjoy the musical!

en_US:
Pokémon Props each have their own image:
cool, cute, elegant, or quirky.{VAR BE01}
Before you play Dress Up, take a moment
to think about the image you prefer.

I'm not trying to brag, but we're
rather rich.{VAR BE01}
When you say rich people, you think
musical. It's a matter of taste, I guess.

Your Pokémon are wonderful!
I'm always watching them.{VAR BE01}
I hope you can keep entertaining us with
your performances.
There is a Musical Photo saved from
last time!{VAR BE01}
You can hang Musical Photos from your
previous shows here.
Know what? When there are cute Pokémon,
my eyes are glued to the stage!
